title: English Practice Quiz 0880
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Listen! The baby ___.
questions.explanation: Listen! suggests an action happening now, so use the present continuous.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: A person you can trust is ___.
She is ___ university student.
questions.explanation: University begins with the consonant sound /y/, so use a.

questions.question: She is interested ___ music.
questions.explanation: The adjective interested is followed by in.

questions.question: Choose the correct word order.
questions.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as always usually come after the verb be.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: How many syllables are in 'computer'?
questions.explanation: Computer is commonly pronounced with three syllables: com-pu-ter.

questions.question: You have completed a task. You say:
questions.explanation: The task is complete is a clear status update.

questions.question: Which question asks for a reason?
